newsitem.title: UK: Reuters, Munich Re launch data service.
newsitem.headline: Reuters, Munich Re launch data service.

text.p: News and information organisation Reuters Holdings Plc said on Monday it had released an electronic information service on natural catastrophes with German reinsurance giant Munich Re.
The Munich Re NatCat service, which has been in a test phase over the past four weeks, is now available via Reuters Insurance Briefing, an online information service.
The NatCat service, in English, describes major catastrophes and provides, where available, an estimate given by Munich Re of the economic loss and the insured loss, among other things.
Each report will be issued as soon as possible after Munich Re considers that it has sufficient data to describe the event accurately, Reuters said in a statement.
The companies expect there will be about 50 reports a month on events taking place around the world.
The data will be gathered by Munich-based staff from both published sources and from Munich Re's own information network.
